name: Robros Showcases Humanoid Platform “IGRIS-C” at CES 2026 HUMANOID M.AX Alliance Pavilion, Targets Overseas Robotics Research Institutes
summary: Robros (CEO Ryan Ro) participated on January 6 (local time) at the HUMANOID M.AX Alliance pavilion at CES 2026, a venue that brings together “Korean-style humanoid” technologies in a single space.
